findings.issue: Diagnostic count increments are unprotected; check increment precedes original try/invalidate, so corrupted diagnostic state such as counts[0]=None raises TypeError before original proof and can bypass sticky invalidation.
findings.derivation: Static source analysis only; not a run/probe.
findings.minimum_fix: Isolate both increments with narrow Exception handling so original input_key/check executes normally even if diagnostics are damaged. Keep all full graph checks and original exception order. Existing stage sampling may mark incomplete when counters unusable.
findings.validation: One local existing-CGR synthetic case with unusable diagnostic counter should still serialize full original bytes for valid input, then reject mutated original input with DomainError and sticky invalidation.

accepted_boundaries: end=time.time then original pin then one stop read; min remains short-circuited when stopped
finite expressions retain original ordering and parallel constant labels
five stage spans only local monotonic snapshots and count deltas; no new SQL/hash/full graph walk
RunCheck/actual row scalar snapshot captured before later mutation
rejection annotation private; DomainError.public and message unchanged
first-admission diagnostic only; no PB performance or qualification claim
